title: Chapter 1384
text:
The elimination of the intercepting circle meant that the war had entered a new stage. The World Tree had the coordinates of the Kunde Race refugees, and the army left behind temporary strongholds along the way. They split into multiple routes and headed toward the Flickering World. Like green roots that grew endlessly in the universe, they slowly extended toward the territory of the three Universal Civilizations, spreading inch by inch.

The three Universal Civilizations, on the other hand, used beyond-visual-range weapons and harassing tactics to delay the enemy.

The players did not have much of a reaction to the loss of the intercepting circle, and their morale was not affected. In their eyes, this was just a normal development of the main storyline. At most, some players who liked the storyline would post on the forums to analyze the future trend of the war, but most of them were just guesses.

What had the greatest impact was the players' Main Storyline Mission that was ongoing. The requirements had changed, and the condition of guarding the intercepting circle had been crossed out to stop the World Tree army as much as possible.

However, most of the players were quite happy. The Spacetime Splicing Tactic had a place to be used again. They had realized that they were reemployed, and there were more job opportunities.

During the war, mercenary participants like the players were the happiest. The reward level of the mission had obviously increased by several levels, and their wallets were filling up several times faster.

During the harassment phase, the three Universal Civilizations had left a large number of death squad positions for the players, which made it convenient for Han Technician. He did not have to divert his attention to fertilize the players, and his energy was focused elsewhere.

…

Flickering World, Black Star territory.

A huge metal fortress floated in the starry sky. It was triangular in shape, and every corner had a slender magnetic field confinement track. It looked like a transparent pipe, but it was actually a fast shuttle bridge that connected to a crescent-shaped mechanical device at the end. These three devices were like suction cups, sucking in three stars from afar. They were all celestial bodies that had been moved over. After special treatment such as gravitational restraint and energy restraint, they were very stable.

The three crescent-shaped mechanical devices were called Star Guides, used to guide the energy of the celestial bodies. This was a model that was used for individual cultivation. It could temper the body, charge the energy, and strengthen the endurance. It could adjust the output power of the celestial bodies.

This metal fortress was a specially built training ground, equipped with all kinds of top-notch training facilities, such as the Star Training Room that tempered the body with Star Power, the Environment Simulation Room that converted all kinds of cosmic radiation, the Extreme Gravity Room with ultra-high density, and so on. There were also cultivation type Universal Treasures provided by the three Universal Civilizations and many Beyond Grade As, which could stimulate the potential of different races and systems. It could be said to be the best training ground for Supers in the entire explored universe.

Those who could receive training here were not ordinary people. More than ninety-five percent of the Beyond Grade A seeds in the entire explored universe were sent here, regardless of whether they were civilians or direct descendants of civilizations. At the same time, there were also other Calamity Grades with potential selected by the various large organizations.

At this moment, in the open-air square of the training ground, a small group of people stood in formation. They looked at the row of figures in front of them with almost fanaticism. Most of their gazes were focused on Han Xiao in the center position.

"All of you are Calamity Grade Supers. I believe there is no need for me to explain why you are here. From today onwards, all the facilities here will be free for all of you to use. We will set up a training schedule for all of you, and in our free time, we will answer all of your training problems … "

Han Xiao spoke loudly as he scanned the crowd in front of him.

The establishment of this training ground was also the intention of the three Universal Civilizations. Originally, the direct descendants were all receiving training in the various military bases, but now, they were all sent here by the three Universal Civilizations. The group of people in front of him were all high-level Calamity Grades, including all the top Supers in the explored universe below the Beyond Grade A level.

They provided the best facilities, the strongest teachers, and the best resources in order to produce as many Beyond Grade As as possible in eleven years … Facing the suffocating power of the World Tree, the three Universal Civilizations could not care less about the Super imbalance.

"Understood!"

Hardaway shouted excitedly. The hundreds of Beyond Grade A seeds who had already joined the Black Star Corps immediately agreed. Under their lead, the people of the other organizations also responded.

Han Xiao glanced at him. There were many familiar faces among them. The Beyond Grade A seeds of the Black Star Corps had also been added to the training list by him. Lagi, Hardaway, Jotina, Nero, Mia, and the others were among them.

However, not all the potential stocks participated in the training. Some of the golden leeks who were especially promising were given special treatment in private, such as Carrott, Evans, and the others.

"However, let me say the ugly words first. All the people who become Beyond Grade As in the training have to participate in the war unconditionally as your tuition fee. Otherwise, we will take back your strength. This is a deal. It's not too late to back out now."

Hearing this, the excitement on everyone's faces did not change at all. They had long known the price.

However, the value of this training was extraordinary. Most of the Beyond Grade A seeds present had grown on their own. In the past, there was no way they could casually use such treasures, and they could even consult different Beyond Grade As at any time. Even if they joined a Beyond Grade A organization, they would not receive such treatment. Compared to such benefits, participating in the war was nothing.

Just as everyone was excited, an unsociable voice suddenly sounded from the crowd.

"Sigh, I'm going to be sacrificed in the war anyway. What's the point of becoming stronger …"

Han Xiao's eyes twitched.

The style was too obvious. He did not even need to look to know who was speaking.

He immediately said, "I'll say this in advance. Our training is compulsory. No slacking in any form is allowed, and the rest time is strictly controlled. Some people better be careful."

"Sigh, totalitarianism …"

It was still the same voice that sighed.

Han Xiao could not be bothered with this Lagi and continued.

"Alright, I won't say anything unnecessary. I've already made a corresponding timetable for each of you. These instructors will be responsible for training you. Begin immediately. From now on, it's best not to waste a single second."

As he spoke, the more than ten Beyond Grade As beside him walked forward and took away batches of Calamity Grades to train them separately.

Some ordinary Beyond Grade As who did not have much room to grow were more enthusiastic about being instructors. As long as they could train more comrades, they would be able to share the pressure. Their experience was also precious to the Calamity Grades.

"I hope that in eleven years, there will be more than ten Beyond Grade As among this group of people …"

Han Xiaoxin thought to himself.

Gathering all the potential stocks in the universe to help them grow, there was a chance for there to be a double-digit number of Beyond Grade As in eleven years. It was equivalent to helping a batch of leeks that had almost grown.

With his targeted training, the guidance of the Beyond Grade As, and the support of a large number of resources, the chances of a high-level Calamity Grade completing the last step should be many times higher.

Watching the group of potential stocks being taken away for training, Han Xiao turned to look at the other Beyond Grade As and nodded.

"It's the same for us. If there's a need, I can give you training suggestions."

There were two batches of targets for the training. One was the Calamity Grades, and the other was the Beyond Grade As. The two were naturally different, and he was directly in charge of the latter.

The many Beyond Grade As had been watching from the sidelines. At this moment, they looked at each other and felt a little awkward.

Those who could advance to the Beyond Grade A realm were all geniuses. They had all found their own path and had been groping for their own cultivation. Suddenly, they had to accept the guidance of others. Many of them were not used to it.

However, Han Xiao's prestige was very high. Everyone present had agreed to the training plan he had proposed during the regular meeting, so they could not go back on their words now. One by one, they came up to take the needles, which made Han Xiao feel good.

Han Xiao took this opportunity to collect information on most of the Beyond Grade As and analyzed their abilities.

Why do I feel like I'm a Pokémon trainer …

After analyzing for a while, this thought suddenly appeared in Han Xiao's mind.

On the other side, when the many Beyond Grade As saw Black Star accurately point out their weaknesses and even give an effective training plan, they could not help but be stunned.

They knew that Black Star had a good eye, but it was all hearsay. Now that they had seen it for themselves, they could not help but be interested.

"Could it be that you've grown so fast because of this ability?" Oulou was surprised.

"To a certain extent, that's indeed the case." Han Xiao spread his hands.

"The title of Super Teacher should be given to you. If you were in the Radiant Federation, I might have lost my job." Verena had a helpless expression.

"Don't worry, it's not too late to lose your job now."

Han Xiao could not be bothered to speak human language. After distributing the training plan, he urged everyone to hurry up and cultivate.

Although he really wanted to find someone to spar with and try to draw abilities, the training had just begun, so it was better to let others get used to it first.

The many Beyond Grade As dispersed. Their training ground was not this training base. Han Xiao had modified a few planets nearby to serve as temporary training grounds for the Beyond Grade As. For the next eleven years, most people would be active around this area. However, this was only limited to ordinary Beyond Grade As and some high-grade Beyond Grade As. People like Kasuyi, Manison, Hella, and the others all had their own special training routes and did not need to come here for training.

After doing all this, Han Xiao was about to return to the workshop to continue his research when his communicator suddenly rang. The caller was the department leader in charge of contacting the secondary dimension expedition team.

"Your Excellency Black Star, I have bad news for you. In the last contact, we discovered that the fleet carrying the emissary you sent out has disappeared. We are unable to contact him at the moment."

"Disappeared?"

Han Xiao's eyes moved, and he silently activated the Observer's Mark.

When Harrison had set off, he had used his Void talent to set an Observer's Mark on Harrison. Because he had not gained anything for a long time, he would not constantly check. The last time he checked was a day and a half ago, and everything was normal.

Activating his ability, his vision suddenly changed, leaving only a deep darkness. He could not see Harrison's figure at all.

Before he could take a closer look, his vision suddenly disappeared, which meant that the Observer's Mark had been destroyed.

"Did I encounter something in the secondary dimensions?"

Han Xiao frowned. To be able to destroy his Observer's Mark, there was a high chance that it was a Beyond Grade A Energy Rank.

Without hesitation, he changed into a specific King and directly teleported to the throne that Harrison had taken away.

…

With a flash of light, his surroundings turned upside down. Han Xiao had already arrived in a space that was like a black ocean. There was nothing else around.

The throne should have been in Harrison's room, but at this moment, the fleet was gone, and Harrison and the other crew members were nowhere to be seen. Only the throne was left floating alone.

"What is this place?"

Han Xiao looked around and was surprised to find that his energy senses seemed to have disappeared. He could not sense the situation in this deep sea, and the mechanical suit's radar also malfunctioned. At the same time, his vision was greatly suppressed, and he could not see his fingers in front of him.

He released a group of detectors and connected them with Mechanical Force. However, the detectors only flew a short distance before they suddenly lost their connection. It was as if they had been swallowed by this black ocean.

Han Xiao tried to shoot a few energy beams in one direction, but they were like clay oxen entering the sea. There was no reaction at all.

"This secondary dimension is quite strange. What did Harrison encounter?"

Han Xiao's eyes flickered.

The secondary dimension world was filled with all kinds of possibilities, and anything could happen. The water was very deep, and this expedition team had already been in it for more than a year. He could not say what accidents would happen.

Just as Han Xiao was about to set off to search this secondary dimension, a huge pressure suddenly came from all directions, and there was a loud rumbling sound. It was as if this black ocean was suddenly roaring and pressing toward him.

At the same time, a mental wave with a cold aura suddenly invaded his mind, and a solemn and ancient voice sounded.

"Foreign high-level life form, leave immediately, or you will become the enemy of the Realmless King!"
